description: Softmax: turn a vector of scores into probabilities, each score exponentiated and divided by the sum of all of them.

line_docs: All the probabilities at once: exponentiate the scores, divide by their sum, assign to P.
m.purpose: Read right to left: *Z exponentiates every score at once, +/ adds the results up, ÷ divides the exponentials by that sum, and P receives all the probabilities. No index appears. Placeholder glyphs.
m.title: The same in the proposed notation

line_docs: The i-th probability: e to the i-th score over the sum of e to every score.
math.purpose: One line: the i-th probability is e to the i-th score, divided by the sum over j of e to every score. The division makes the probabilities add up to one; the exponential makes the biggest score dominate.
math.title: The equation as written on paper

name: softmax

docs: The output: σ(z), the softmax of the scores, a probability for each entry; they add up to one.
Open parenthesis: the scores the softmax is applied to.
The scores (logits): one number per entry, any size; here five, divided by the temperature at this step.
Which entry's probability this line gives.
Definition: the left side is computed from the right side.
e raised to a score: always positive, and growing fast, so big scores win by a lot. In the notation, *.
Divide each exponential by the sum of all of them, so the results add up to one.
Add up every exponential: the normaliser. On paper a ∑ over j, in the notation +/.
Runs over every entry inside the sum, 1 to n.
How many scores there are; here 5.

title: Softmax

visual.purpose: Three rows of bars: the scores divided by the temperature, their exponentials, and the probabilities they become. As the temperature falls the scores spread out and one probability takes over.
visual.title: Scores, exponentials, probabilities, as the temperature falls
